name: ONTOLOGY2 -- the dynamic rails between C0-C3: flow as primitive, freshness as its derivative
description: Andrew-direct charter 2026-07-23 (verbatim in PRD s.0): the ratified C0-C3 ladder models STRUCTURE; agents ask DYNAMIC questions (what moved, did it arrive, is it current). Add three additive rails BETWEEN the rungs -- D1 VALUE/GRAIN (C0-C1: what travels an edge, at what grain; seed = derives-from's ratified EdgeKind passthrough|rename|recompute_guarded), D2 PATH/FLOW (C1-C2: directed typed path + per-hop transform + cadence), D3 CONTRACT/OBLIGATION (C2-C3: what a motif promises vs does). Derived properties are DEFINED as derivations, never primitives: freshness = D2 path + D3 cadence + upstream vintages + calendar (Andrew: freshness is downstream of flow, not a separate aspect); provenance/canonical-origin = D1 grain + D2 walked backward (= MSBEFF R2 comp-dataflow, as a query over D2 rather than a bespoke tool); blast = D2 forward-walk at a declared grain. Closes the measured failure signature: MSBEFF's 253 coverage failures are LAYER MISMATCHES the estate could not name.
